name: Northlight
note: A white ground lit by the Northlight sun: soft warm-gray panels with 16 px corners, Inter throughout, from tracked labels to headings, a fine sun-gradient ring on the primary action, the open view raised on layered soft shadows, an edge glow that breathes and swells when the OS acts, and a faint aura that follows the cursor. Night mode is the logo’s violet sky.
signature: Cream panels on white and a sun-gradient hairline (#ebc913 → #e77103 → #dc3286 → #8f6ab7 → #8bb1d3), with ambient light at the edges.
